summary: Iteration 2 re-verification of UnderScope. Backend: rewrote assistant SSE tests to client-identical JSON-frame parsing plus byte-integrity check; added 404 consistency tests for /news, /events, /dependencies. 27/28 pytest cases pass (only new /dependencies 404-consistency test fails). CRITICAL SSE framing defect from iteration 1 is FIXED: every frame is now `data: {"t": "..."}`, zero orphan frames, newlines survive, aggregated length == sum of JSON payload lengths. Frontend: assistant answers now render as real markdown (h2/strong/ul/li/p) with no raw '##'/'**' leakage and no text loss; mobile (390x844) topbar shows 'Ask' and opens the panel; /discover is its own view and the sector <select> correctly filters 24 -> filtered cards; full journey Home -> Companies -> /company/NVDA -> all 8 tabs -> Watchlist add -> Compare add/remove -> Scenario Lab sliders -> grounded AI streaming all pass with no console errors (except one pre-existing tooling warning on /compare).

minor.issue: Unknown ticker returns 200 with {"dependency_map": {"center": "ZZZZ", "nodes": []}} instead of 404. /news and /events were fixed this iteration; /dependencies is now the only inconsistent one (test_dependencies_404_unknown_ticker fails).
Still no per-request timeout guard on the LLM stream and Q&A is never persisted to Mongo (motor client effectively unused).

ui_bugs.issue: Topbar button always calls setAssistantCtx({}), so on /company/NVDA it opens an UNGROUNDED assistant ('Ask a research question'); the model replies 'I don't have a specific company loaded'. Should inherit the ticker when on a company route (the in-page [data-testid=ask-analyst] correctly grounds it).

Container keeps `whitespace-pre-wrap` while now rendering block-level markdown, so paragraph/list gaps are doubled (visible 3-4 blank-line gaps between blocks). Remove whitespace-pre-wrap from .assistant-stream when markdown is rendered.
react-markdown is used without remark-gfm, so GFM tables the model emits render as literal pipe text ('| Category | Examples |', '|---|---|'). Add remark-gfm.

Pre-existing React console error persists: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (visual-editing wrapper injected into the dynamic expression inside <option> at Compare.jsx:79). Functionality unaffected.

issues: Excessive vertical whitespace between markdown blocks (pre-wrap + block markdown)
No visual distinction/badges for FACT / REPORTED EVENT / AI INTERPRETATION labels the model emits inline

action_items: Return 404 for unknown tickers on /api/companies/{ticker}/dependencies (last inconsistent endpoint).
Make the topbar Ask Analyst inherit the current company context when on /company/:ticker.
Drop whitespace-pre-wrap on the markdown-rendered assistant text and add remark-gfm for tables.
Optional: silence the <option> child DOM-nesting console error on /compare (use a Select component).
critical_code_review_comments: SSE framing fix verified correct: server.py json.dumps({'t': ...}) + api.js JSON.parse with legacy fallback — byte-for-byte integrity confirmed by test_assistant_multiline_integrity.
AssistantPanel now preserves partial text on error (fixed).
Company.jsx is still ~392 lines with 8 inline tab components; consider splitting.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (JSON-aware SSE parsing + integrity assertions, 404 consistency tests)
seed_data_creation: None — public demo data. LocalStorage watchlist entry for NVDA created during testing.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (28 tests). _read_sse() helper parses SSE exactly like src/lib/api.js and asserts each data frame is {'t': str}; test_assistant_multiline_integrity is the SSE regression guard (now passing). Only failing test: test_dependencies_404_unknown_ticker. Frontend verified this iteration: /discover themes + sector filter, mobile Ask button, grounded vs ungrounded assistant, markdown rendering, 8 company tabs, watchlist, compare add/remove, scenario sliders. Remaining known cosmetic items: assistant whitespace, missing remark-gfm, <option> console warning.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-1 CRITICAL (assistant text loss) root cause was raw newlines in SSE data fields; fix (json.dumps per delta + JSON.parse client-side) verified end-to-end — 0 orphan frames and aggregated UI text matches SSE payload. Remaining /dependencies 200-on-unknown-ticker is because the handler builds a default empty dependency_map instead of validating the ticker against the company registry first.
